title: Liberman's goldfish centrifuge-and-freezing experiment

tellings.quote: a lot of this is centered around an experiment he did with goldfish he took four goldfish

plain: A Soviet scientist named Efim Liberman is said to have built much of his thinking on an experiment with four goldfish, which, as the story's title gives it, involved spinning them in a centrifuge and freezing them. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, in a conversation about the idea that the brain works like a quantum time machine, and he also names David and Daniil Liberman. He says only that he took four goldfish, so how the experiment went and what it showed stays vague.
